name: Transcribe
about: Notes from a recording — on the device, offline. A library recording becomes a .mid file: listen, open in the studio.
empty: No recordings in the library. Record in the voice recorder or looper, or add a file in the library.
opt.title: How to transcribe
opt.bendsHint: Bends and slides — for voice, guitar, violin
hint: Most accurate with one instrument or voice. Polyphony works, but a full-band mix is better split in Stems first.
doneHint: The .mid file sits in the library next to the recording. In the studio the notes can be edited, re-voiced and re-timed.
none: No notes found: a quiet recording or one without pitch
studioMade: Studio project created — the Studio tab
help.1: Tap a recording to transcribe. The .mid file lands in the library next to it; tap again to open the result.
help.2: “Open in the studio” — the notes on a track: edit, change the sound, learn the part piece by piece.
help.3: Best input is a vocal or bass stem from Stems: a single voice transcribes most accurately.
